mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, enterprise_id, name, phone, id_card, factory_id, deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM resident_factory WHERE enterprise_id = CAST(#{enterpriseId} AS CHAR) AND account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY deleted DESC, id DESC FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, account_id, enterprise_id, name, phone, id_card, factory_id, deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM resident_factory WHERE id = #{residentId} AND enterprise_id = CAST(#{enterpriseId} AS CHAR) AND deleted = 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, enterprise_id, name, status, account_type FROM account WHERE id = #{accountId} AND enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND account_type = 2 AND status != 2 AND deleted = 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM account WHERE id = #{accountId} AND status = 1 AND account_type IN (1, 2) AND deleted = 1 FOR SHARE
SELECT * FROM enterprise WHERE id = #{enterpriseId} AND deleted = 1 FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE resident_factory SET account_id = #{accountId}, name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, id_card = #{idCard}, factory_id = #{factoryId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, enterprise_id = CAST(#{enterpriseId} AS CHAR), deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND enterprise_id = CAST(#{enterpriseId} AS CHAR) AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT rf.id AS id, rf.account_id AS accountId, rf.name AS name, rf.phone AS phone, rf.id_card AS idCard, rf.factory_id AS factoryId, f.factory_name AS factoryName, rf.create_by AS createBy, a.name AS createByName, a.account AS createByAccount, rf.create_time AS createTime FROM resident_factory rf INNER JOIN factory f ON f.id = rf.factory_id AND rf.enterprise_id = CAST(f.enterprise_id AS CHAR) AND f.deleted = 1 AND f.factory_status = 1 LEFT JOIN account a ON a.id = rf.create_by AND (rf.enterprise_id = CAST(a.enterprise_id AS CHAR) OR a.account_type = 1) WHERE rf.enterprise_id = CAST(#{enterpriseId} AS CHAR) AND rf.deleted = 1 ORDER BY rf.create_time DESC, rf.id DESC

SELECT rf.id AS id, rf.name AS name, rf.phone AS phone, rf.factory_id AS factoryId, f.factory_name AS factoryName, rf.create_time AS createTime FROM resident_factory rf INNER JOIN factory f ON f.id = rf.factory_id AND rf.enterprise_id = CAST(f.enterprise_id AS CHAR) AND f.deleted = 1 AND f.factory_status = 1 WHERE rf.enterprise_id = CAST(#{enterpriseId} AS CHAR) AND rf.deleted = 1
AND rf.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY rf.create_time DESC, rf.id DESC
